title: Continuously shrink binary size & startup time
description:
Project rule: speed and size are permanent priorities, not one-time targets. After every dependency change or feature, re-measure exe size and cold-start.

Concrete levers to investigate, ordered by likely payoff:

1. Static-link SQLite — vendor sqlite3.c amalgamation, compile via cl.exe in MSBuild BeforeTargets="LinkNative", DirectPInvoke + NativeLibrary. Eliminates e_sqlite3.dll (-1.7MB file count, ~+700KB into exe).
2. Drop ANGLE (av_libglesv2.dll, 5.2MB) — Win32PlatformOptions { CompositionMode = [Software / Direct2D1] }. Validate rendering quality on older GPUs, RDP, VMs before committing.
3. Surface individual trim warnings (TrimmerSingleWarn=false) — see what Microsoft.Data.Sqlite drags in via reflection; add TrimmerRoots / DynamicDependency to root only what's needed.
4. Profile the published exe with sizoscope (https://github.com/MichalStrehovsky/sizoscope) — find unexpected size hogs in our own assembly tree.
5. Try IlcDisableReflection=true — aggressive; risk of breaking Avalonia at runtime. Validate carefully against compiled XAML bindings.
6. Custom TrimmerRoot fine-tuning — explicit roots for SQLite types we use; remove auto-rooted assemblies we don't need.
7. Re-measure after Avalonia patch bumps (11.3.x) — their footprint changes between releases.

Acceptance: any change here must be validated by (a) exe size before/after in bytes, (b) cold-start to first paint before/after, (c) a clean run of the app with multiple notes. No regressions to startup time, ever.

title: AOT single-file publish
description: dotnet publish -r win-x64 -c Release -p:PublishAot=true. Target: <25MB single-file exe, no .NET install required, cold start <300ms. May need TrimmerRootDescriptor + DirectPInvoke tweaks for Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.
close_reason: AOT publish working. Stickies.exe = 15.5MB (under 25MB target). Size-tuning: Fluent theme dropped for Simple, Inter font dropped for system, IlcOptimizationPreference=Size + DebuggerSupport/EventSourceSupport/MetadataUpdaterSupport off. True single-file not pursued (Avalonia native deps Skia/HarfBuzz/ANGLE cannot reasonably be static-linked); ships as exe + 4 platform DLLs. SQLite static-link is a separate follow-up.

title: Single-instance enforcement
description: Mutex 'Local\Stickies.SingleInstance' + named pipe 'Stickies.IPC'. Second launch writes verb (NEW/SHOW/OPEN:<id>) and exits; running instance dispatches via Dispatcher.UIThread.Post. ShutdownMode = OnExplicitShutdown.
close_reason: Mutex + named pipe shipped; verbs SHOW/NEW/OPEN:<id>; verified end-to-end (3 existing notes loaded, --new routed via pipe to spawn 4th, second launch exits in <400ms, process count stays at 1)

title: GitHub release pipeline: PR build gating + tagged releases (absorbs 94r MSI)
description:
Set up the project's GitHub Actions pipeline end-to-end so v1 can ship from a tag instead of a local 'dotnet publish' + manual upload. Two halves:

1. PR/push build gating (.github/workflows/ci.yml): on push to main and on PR to main, build Release with PublishAot=true on windows-latest, fail on any new compiler warning, fail on new IL trim warnings on the managed surface (only the pre-existing Microsoft.Data.Sqlite IL2104 is allowed), and fail if the published Stickies.exe exceeds a size budget anchored to the current 16.6MB baseline (hard cap 25MB per CLAUDE.md, soft cap a few % over current).

2. Tag-driven release (.github/workflows/release.yml): on push of a tag matching v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+, build the same Release publish, package both a zipped Stickies.exe (current shipping form) and a per-user MSI (this absorbs the 94r WiX v5 work — perUser scope, no UAC, no auto-update), create a GitHub Release with auto-generated notes from commits since the previous tag, and attach both artifacts.

Defers smoke-test-of-published-binary into a later bead — for this round we only need 'builds, gates, ships'. Code-signing is also out of scope (no cert yet).
design:
- Split into ci.yml + release.yml for clarity (vs. one combined workflow)
- Tag scheme: SemVer v0.1.0 etc
- Concurrency: PR runs cancel-in-progress per PR; release runs don't cancel each other
- NuGet cache via actions/setup-dotnet; AOT compile cache deferred unless build time is painful
- Size budget: enforced via PowerShell step that reads (Get-Item bin/...).Length and fails if > threshold
- IL warning gate: build with -warnaserror except IL2104 from Microsoft.Data.Sqlite (known)
- Absorbs Stickies-94r: that bead gets superseded by this one, MSI work happens inside release.yml (no separate WiX-only scope)
- 94r 'no auto-update' constraint preserved — Release page is the only update channel
acceptance_criteria:
- ci.yml runs on PR + push to main, fails on new warnings/IL, fails on size regressions
- release.yml runs on v*.*.* tag, produces zipped exe + per-user MSI, creates GitHub Release with notes
- Both workflows green on a dry-run tag (e.g. v0.0.1-pipeline-test)
- 94r MSI requirements (WiX v5, perUser, no UAC) satisfied within release.yml

title: WiX v5 MSI installer (perUser, no UAC)
description: WixToolset.Sdk MSBuild SDK. Scope=perUser. Installs Stickies.exe to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Stickies, Start Menu shortcut. No code-signing for v1 (SmartScreen warning expected). Depends on AOT publish.

title: Global hotkey (Win+Shift+N spawns note)

close_reason: HotkeyHost (1x1 invisible Window) registers Win+Shift+N via RegisterHotKey + AddWndProcHookCallback. Verified end-to-end: hotkey spawns a new note. AOT-clean (LibraryImport).

close_reason: ContextMenu attached to root Border with New note (Ctrl+N) / Delete (Ctrl+D); existing keybindings preserved via shared DeleteNote() helper. Also folded in default Topmost=True per user direction.

close_reason: Pinned column + menu toggle. Notes default pinned (matches rt1 baseline). Verified: toggle drops/raises Topmost, menu header updates, persists across restart.

title: 2.5D peel/fall-away animation on Ctrl+N
description:
When the user spawns a new note (Ctrl+N, menu, or Win+Shift+N), play a brief 2.5D animation: the new note appears as if peeling off the existing top note, like tearing a sheet from a sticky pad.

Two implementation paths to choose between:

**A. True 2.5D perspective (Skia direct)**
- Render the new note as a Visual, capture to bitmap.
- Custom Avalonia Control overrides Render(), casts DrawingContext to ISkiaSharpApiLeaseFeature.
- Apply SKMatrix44 perspective transform across animation timeline (CompositionAnimation or DispatcherTimer).
- Effect: bottom-right corner lifts toward viewer, rotates around top edge.
- Cost: ~200-300 lines. Need to verify AOT compatibility of raw SkiaSharp managed API (Avalonia uses it internally but our project doesn't reference SkiaSharp directly).

**B. 2D fall-away (Avalonia transforms)**
- Use built-in RotateTransform + TranslateTransform + opacity animations on the new Window.
- New note appears slightly tilted (~15°), slides into final position, opacity fades in.
- Cost: ~50 lines. No raw Skia.
- Looks ~80% as satisfying for ~10% the code.

Tension with project ethos:
- CLAUDE.md: 'cold start <300ms to first paint' — animation budget eats into perceived responsiveness.
- 'Reliable, no nonsense' — flashy animations are nonsense to some users.
- Could ship with a setting to disable, or just keep the duration tiny (~150ms total).

Pre-decision: see HTML demo in .superpowers/brainstorm/ for both styles before picking A or B.

Skia is already shipping at 9.4MB — this lights it up at zero binary cost.
notes:
Brainstorm 2026-05-06 — design confirmed (saved in .superpowers/brainstorm/632696-1778039163/):

TARGET END-STATE (post-fold visual):
- Dark back-of-paper triangle in the bottom-left QUADRANT of the note.
- Triangle vertices in corner-area-local coords: TL (0,0), TR (100%, 0), BR (100%, 100%).
- clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%).
- Right angle at TR. Hypotenuse along the `\` diagonal from TL to BR.

CONFIRMED MECHANICS (from peel-v3 stage-F demo):
- corner-area: 110×110 box anchored at bottom-left of note (bottom: 0; left: 0).
- Front-face clip: polygon(0 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%) — visible BL tip triangle, right angle at BL.
- Back-face same shape, transform: rotateY(180deg), backface-visibility: hidden.
- Hinge: transform-origin = (0%, 0%); axis = (1, 1, 0) — runs along the front-face's hypotenuse (TL→BR diagonal of corner-area).
- Animation: rotate3d(1, 1, 0, 0deg → 180deg).
- Duration: 700ms with cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.4, 1).
- Drop shadow: radial gradient under the lifting flap, fades in over 350ms with 100ms delay.
- Back-of-paper color: #c9b853 (significantly darker than #FFF59E so the fold reads).
- Perspective: 600px, perspective-origin: 30% 70%.

USER FEEDBACK ITERATION:
- v1 (peel-demo.html): showed A/B/C — page-flip / corner-peel / minimal. User: "not literally 3D" — wanted 2.5D.
- v2 (peel-fold-demo.html): showed D (hard half-fold) / E (corner curl with hinge bug). User: "E decent but corner lift animation misplaced."
- v3 (peel-fold-v2.html): fixed hinge to align with hypotenuse. User: "still not correct" + reference image.
- v3.5 (peel-v3.html): F (bigger flap, dark back, drop shadow) / G (tear-off-and-float) / H (lift-then-fold).
- v4 (peel-orient.html): static end-state variants. User: "variant 2 looks correct" (= TL/TR/BR triangle = current F end-state).

REMAINING DECISIONS BEFORE IMPLEMENTING:
- Pick A (true 2.5D via raw Skia) vs B (Avalonia transforms) vs use Avalonia's MatrixTransform + perspective workaround.
- Decide: animate the OLD note's corner peeling away (closing animation), or the NEW note's corner peeling on (opening animation)? The demo showed peeling-away semantics.
- Performance budget: animation must not jank cold-start (<300ms to first paint).
- Settings toggle to disable for users who want zero animation (per "no nonsense" ethos)?

title: Inline markdown rendering (no toolbar)
description:
Type **bold** / *italic* / # heading / - bullet directly in the textbox. When the note loses focus, the syntax renders as styled text. When focus returns, drop back to plain markdown source for editing.

Per CLAUDE.md no formatting toolbars are allowed — this is markdown-source-as-the-input, no UI buttons. The user types raw markdown; rendering is automatic on blur.

Implementation sketch:
- Stay on TextBox for editing (current state). Add a sibling TextBlock for rendered display.
- Toggle visibility on focus/blur of the TextBox.
- Light parser (~50-100 lines, regex-based) that walks markdown and emits Avalonia Inlines: Run, Bold (FontWeight=Bold), Italic (FontStyle=Italic), Span (for headers — increase FontSize), LineBreak, etc.
- Support: **bold**, *italic*, # / ## headings, - bullets, [link](url) (clickable),  (FontFamily=monospace, subtle background).
- No tables, no code fences, no images here (separate bead for images: Stickies-edb).

Why this is on-brand:
- No toolbar = honors the lean / no-formatting-UI rule.
- Pure plain-text storage — markdown source is what's in the DB.
- Avalonia text rendering pipeline (Skia + HarfBuzz) handles all the typography heavy lifting at zero added binary cost.

Open questions for design:
- Edit mode: full plain text source, or live preview (mixed)?
- Persistence is plain markdown — no schema change needed.
- Tab key behavior in lists?
- Keep text rendering monospace-ish for editing clarity, or always proportional?

Brainstorm before implementing.

title: Image paste in notes
description:
Ctrl+V an image from clipboard → renders inline in the note below the text. Apple Stickies has had this for years; Windows Sticky Notes does not.

Implementation sketch:
- Schema: 'attachments' table (id, note_id, blob, mime, created_at) keyed to notes. Or BLOB column on notes if 1-image-per-note suffices.
- Paste handler in TextBox / Window — Avalonia's TopLevel.Clipboard, check for image format, persist BLOB.
- Render via Avalonia <Image> control. Skia decodes PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF natively (no NuGet additions — libSkiaSharp.dll already shipping).
- Layout: image fills width, scales proportionally, sits below text (or above? UX decision).
- Resize note to accommodate? Or scroll? UX decision.
- Right-click menu: 'Remove image' on the image.

Open questions for design:
- One image per note, or multiple?
- Drag-and-drop in addition to paste?
- Where in the note layout — top, bottom, replace text mode?
- Persistence size limit (DB grows fast with images)?

Brainstorm before implementing — image-handling features have many small UX decisions.

Skia is already shipping as part of Avalonia (libSkiaSharp.dll, 9.4MB). This feature lights it up at zero binary cost.

title: Replace native ChooseColor with a nicer custom picker
description:
The native Win32 ChooseColor dialog used by the '…' swatch (Stickies-265) works and is AOT-clean / zero-binary-cost, but the UI is dated (Win95-era look). User flagged this as a future polish item.

Options to evaluate:
1. Custom Avalonia popup — small HSV/HSL surface + hex input. Most code, full control, no new deps.
2. Expanded preset palette (e.g. 32 colors in a 4×8 grid) — replace ChooseColor entirely with a richer palette inside the existing menu. No modal dialog. Trade: no truly arbitrary color.
3. Avalonia.Controls.ColorPicker NuGet package — easy, but measure binary-size delta and confirm AOT compatibility before committing.

Decide via Stickies-d0q's lens: what's the size cost vs. UX gain. Option 2 is probably the sweet spot.

title: Per-note color
description: Add 'color' column to notes. Default yellow #FFF59E. Picker in context menu — small preset palette (yellow, pink, blue, green, gray). Header strip auto-derives a darker shade.
close_reason: 5 presets + custom picker via Win32 ChooseColor shipped. User confirms colors apply, header auto-darkens, custom picker opens. UX of native dialog tracked for revisit in Stickies-har.

description: Per-note or bulk export via TopLevel.GetTopLevel(this)?.StorageProvider.OpenFolderPickerAsync. .md adds YAML frontmatter (created/updated). AOT-clean.

title: Recycle bin / undelete UI
description: View soft-deleted notes (deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deleted_at DESC). Restore moves deleted_at back to NULL. Hard delete via DELETE FROM notes WHERE id=. Optional 30-day auto-purge.
